mails.subject: Re: Can you help me with ancienttrees.app? Stockholm
mails.body:
Hi Daniel,

We are starting with ambassadors: one person per city who adds photographs, checks the facts and helps sharpen the list, named on the city's page. Would you be up for Stockholm? You have already done most of it.

The Latin names are live on the website now, and they come to the app with the next update.

Thanks,
Hidde
mails.resend_reason: Third mail in a live thread: the ambassador ask for Stockholm, in Hidde's own dictated wording, plus the Latin names he was told about.
